content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) publishes a document titled Standards of Care in Diabetes, which outlines the most up-to-date clinical practice recommendations provided by the ADA. These standards encompass critical elements of diabetes management, including treatment objectives, evidence-based guidelines, and tools designed to assess the quality of care being delivered. The ADA Professional Practice Committee, an interprofessional panel of experts, is tasked with revising and updating these standards on an annual basis or more frequently if emerging evidence necessitates changes. For a comprehensive overview of the ADA's standards, position statements, and the evidence grading system used to support their recommendations, individuals are encouraged to consult the introduction and methodology sections available on the ADA's official website.
